checkpoint: P8C agent-loop task resource context wiring
purpose: Validate the narrow wiring from explicit caller-owned taskResourceContext into the existing P7E visual-fallback caller-context path. Prove that runTask accepts task resources only as one of three mutually exclusive explicit visual-knowledge sources, resolves them after the semantic plan, keeps documentPath out of agent-loop and planner knowledge, preserves the default CLI with no task resources, and performs no UI/filesystem provenance discovery.
requiredClaims: without any explicit visual knowledge source runTask retains no visual-fallback knowledge
taskResourceContext is accepted as an explicit third source after semantic planning
one exact Pulsar current-document resource derives the bounded P7E pulsar-document caller context and P7D UTF-8 contract
wrong application, wrong OPEN target or non-Pulsar resources do not authorize the Pulsar visual contract
invalid or ambiguous task resources fail closed before visual execution
visualFallbackContracts, visualFallbackCallerContext and taskResourceContext are pairwise and jointly mutually exclusive
existing explicit-contract and explicit-caller-context sources remain compatible
agent-loop contains no documentPath knowledge and task-resource-context performs no UI, perception, planner or filesystem discovery
task resource resolution occurs after the semantic plan and before intent execution
the default interactive CLI still invokes runTask(task) without taskResourceContext
planner output remains free of taskResourceContext, documentPath, visual fallback surface/postcondition/provider knowledge and coordinates
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This session is contract-only and makes no new physical UI claim.
This session does not say the default CLI owns a document path; it explicitly does not provide taskResourceContext.
This session does not derive resource provenance from current window title, semantic snapshots, OCR, Vision, coordinates, filesystem inspection or planner text.
This session does not add document.open or any new Computer Control mechanic.
This session does not authorize generic Pulsar visual fallback beyond the bounded UTF-8 case already physically validated through P7E.
P7E remains PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED; this session validates only the task-resource invocation wiring.
